text:
No satellite thermal detections were found at this asset (ASSET-F08, rural property) between 4 October and 3 November 2026. NASA FIRMS data from VIIRS (S-NPP, NOAA-20, NOAA-21) and MODIS covered every day of that period, so the result isn't a gap in coverage.

This doesn't prove that no fire occurred. Small, short-lived, cool, or cloud-obscured fires can go undetected. The check also says nothing about burned area, the cause of any change on the ground (harvest, fire, storm, clearing), or anything outside those dates.

In short, there is no satellite evidence of an active fire at the asset in that window. If you need certainty, check burned-area imagery or get a site report. The data is current as of 12 November 2026.
